question_text: The following statements ask about the feelings you may experience when using AI-or when AI is unavailable-to support your academic work. Please indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
I feel uneasy or insecure without the help of AI.
Using AI to assist my studies makes me feel calm and relaxed.
I would feel anxious and frustrated if I could not use AI for my studies.
I have grown accustomed to completing academic tasks with AI; being without it would make me feel unsettled.
Whenever I encounter a difficult problem my first instinct is to hope that AI can help me; otherwise I feel tense.
Interacting with AI (e.g. through chat prompts) is a pleasant experience that makes me feel supported.
The following statements ask about the extent to which you rely on AI to complete academic tasks and improve your efficiency. Please indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
I delegate almost all my academic tasks to AI because it performs them faster and better than I do.
Without the help of AI I find it difficult to complete my assignments efficiently.
I rely on AI (e.g. providing answers and writing suggestions) to improve my learning efficiency.
I can no longer manage complex academic tasks without the assistance of AI.
Compared with doing it myself I prefer to let AI gather information or organize content for me.
In my studies I rely excessively on the ready-made answers or solutions provided by AI.
I feel inadequate in my studies without the support of AI.

The following statements ask about the extent to which you rely on AI for thinking problem-solving judgment and decision-making in your academic work. Please indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
I often ask AI for answers directly without thinking for myself first.
After using AI my ability to analyze and solve problems independently has declined.
When faced with an academic challenge I rely on AI instead of attempting to think it through on my own.
After using AI for an extended period I find that I have become mentally lazy and increasingly want AI to think for me.
I am accustomed to letting AI make judgments and decisions for me rather than fully trusting my own judgment.
In my studies I tend to delegate tasks that require deep thinking to AI.
The following statements ask about your ability to regulate and control your use of AI for academic purposes. Please indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
Even when it is not necessary I find myself involuntarily using AI to assist with my studies.
I have tried to reduce my use of AI but I have never succeeded for long.
Once I start using AI I often find it difficult to stop even after spending considerable time on it.
Sometimes I know I should not rely excessively on AI but I cannot control myself.
I have almost no control over the frequency and duration of my AI use.
I could complete tasks without AI but I cannot resist using it.
If I do not use AI for a period of time I feel a strong urge to use it and may even become irritable.

The following statements ask whether you are more likely to seek emotional or social support from an AI agent than from another person. Please indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
When I need emotional support I am more likely to turn to an AI agent than to another person.
I feel more comfortable sharing personal concerns with an AI agent than with another person.
When I need reassurance I rely more on an AI agent than on another person.
When I feel lonely I am more likely to seek interaction with an AI agent than with another person.
I feel more understood by AI agents than by the people around me.
Please indicate how often you use artificial intelligence (AI) for each of the following activities.
I use AI to find information or obtain answers to questions.
I use AI to summarize articles documents or other information.
I use AI to draft edit or improve written content such as emails reports or presentations.
I use AI to brainstorm ideas or generate creative content.
I use AI to learn new material receive explanations or study for courses.
I use AI to write or debug computer code.
I use AI to analyze data interpret results or create visualizations.
I use AI to compare alternatives evaluate tradeoffs or support decisions.
I use AI to organize or plan everyday activities such as schedules trips meals workouts or budgets.
I use AI for entertainment or personal communication such as creating content translating languages or having conversations.
I interact with AI-powered customer-service tools to ask questions or resolve problems.
I use AI-powered recommendations to discover products music movies news or other content.
I use AI for personal support of advice.
Considering all your AI use approximately how much time do you spend using AI applications on an average day?
